items.title: Mozilla Partners with Mistral to Bring Open-Weight AI Models to Firefox Smart Window
items.blurb: Mozilla has partnered with Mistral AI to offer Mistral Small 4, an open-weight model, in Firefox's Smart Window AI assistant, now in beta. It is recommended for users in France, the US and Canada.

items.title: Beyond 12 Columns: Designing Layouts With Personality
items.blurb: Too many websites look alike. They use familiar layouts, repeat the same patterns, and often leave little impression once you’ve moved on.

items.title: The Compacting Sidebar Blues
items.blurb: You've got a sidebar nav for a web app with icons and text. What happens where vertical space is constrained? Remove the text? But when and how?

items.title: Has the Web Stopped Getting Heavier?
items.blurb: In April, Ethan Gardner showed that web pages started gaining JavaScript almost three times faster after November 2022. We extended his analysis by eight months.

items.title: A New Set of HTML Insertion and Streaming APIs
items.blurb: Chrome is introducing a new set of HTML insertion and streaming methods that provide a more descriptive way to insert HTML into an existing element, along with the ability to stream content directly into the DOM.

items.title: AI Sped Up The Build: How Can Accessibility Testing Keep Up?
items.blurb: AI has sped up how teams design and build, but quality assurance (QA) testing hasn’t kept pace, and the web may be getting less accessible.
